command: --command=select json_build_object('database',current_database(),'address',inet_server_addr(),'port',inet_server_port(),'workspaces',(select json_agg(row_to_json(w)) from (select tenant_id,revision from erp_workspaces) w),'tableCount',(select count(*) from pg_tables where schemaname='public'),'otherClients',(select count(*) from pg_stat_activity where datname=current_database() and pid<>pg_backend_pid()),'roles',(select json_agg(row_to_json(r)) from (select rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolcanlogin from pg_roles where rolname in ('dealtwin_app_login','dealtwin_reset_login')) r));
